target_operation.statement: single assignment; deletion keeps the line/indentation

deletion_method: replace the line with equal-indentation 'pass  # P-: target A deleted'; line numbers are preserved

constraints: tabular_data is a non-empty list of equal-length lists of str/int/float
headers is 'firstrow' or a sequence of names
tablefmt is a string format name
maxcolwidths/maxheadercolwidths are int or sequence or None
legal_input_contract.observation: the returned string, or the exception type and message

declared_inputs.call: tabulate([['hdr','fold'],['1','very long data']], headers='firstrow', tablefmt='plain', maxcolwidths=[10,10], maxheadercolwidths=[None,2])
tabulate([['hdr','fold'],['1','very long data']], headers='firstrow', tablefmt='plain', maxheadercolwidths=[None,2])
tabulate([['hdr','fold'],['1','very long data']], headers='firstrow', tablefmt='plain', maxcolwidths=[10,10])

scope_note: Exact over the declared finite inputs and declared candidate universe U; not a claim over all legal inputs or operations outside U.
